::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** June 30th [1873?]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS University of Iowa; MsL/Y56ma2
:::

Dear [Mr Macmillan](people/person_939.qmd)

Thank you much but it is an impossibility, I have to be at Aylesbury on Monday, and at home again on Saturday.[^1]

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: CMY’s visit to Aylesbury was probably to  the Rev. William Bigg Wither, who had become Rector of Hardwicke, Bucks. in 1871.  She is known to have visited him in 1873.
